description: Per-user AI credit spend leaderboard, daily trends, and anomaly detection from Loki. VictoriaMetrics only has enterprise billing totals — Loki provides per-user daily granularity.

options.content:
## Copilot AI Credit Spend Intelligence

Per-user AI credit consumption sourced from Loki structured logs. VictoriaMetrics captures enterprise-level billing totals from GitHub's billing API. Loki provides per-user daily credit consumption enabling spend leaderboards, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

**1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Standard model usage does not consume credits.**

**Key questions answered:**
- Which users are consuming the most AI credits?
- Is any user spending an unusually high amount on a single day?
- How is credit spend trending week over week?
- What is the average credit spend per active user?

**Data source:** Loki `ai_credits_used` field — 28-day query window maximum.

panels.title: Total AI Credits (28d)
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed across all users in the last 28 days extracted from Loki per-user daily records.

panels.title: Total Spend USD (28d)
panels.description: Total AI credit spend converted to USD (credits x $0.01) across all users in the last 28 days.

panels.title: Users With Credit Spend (28d)
panels.description: Number of distinct users who consumed at least 1 AI credit in the last 28 days. Users with zero credits used only standard models.

targets.expr: count(sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | ai_credits_used > 0 | unwrap ai_credits_used [28d])) > 0)

panels.title: Avg Credits per Active User (28d)
panels.description: Average AI credits consumed per user who had any credit spend in the last 28 days. Rising average indicates increasing premium model adoption.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | unwrap ai_credits_used [28d])) / count(sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | ai_credits_used > 0 | unwrap ai_credits_used [28d])) > 0)

panels.title: Daily AI Credit Consumption (All Users)
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed across all users each day. Spikes indicate days with heavy premium model usage. Use this to identify unusually expensive days and investigate which users drove the cost.

panels.title: Top 25 Users by AI Credit Spend (28d)
panels.description: Users consuming the most AI credits in the last 28 days. High credit consumers are using premium models extensively — review whether the model selection matches the task complexity. Compare this list to the Top Users by LOC Added to see if high spend correlates with high output.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | unwrap ai_credits_used [28d])))

panels.title: Top 25 Users by Spend USD (28d)
panels.description: Users with the highest total AI credit spend in USD in the last 28 days. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Use this for cost allocation and showback reporting to team leads.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | unwrap ai_credits_usd [28d])))

panels.title: Active Users With Zero Credit Spend (28d)
panels.description: Users who were active (sent at least one prompt) but consumed zero AI credits in the last 28 days. These users are exclusively using standard models. They may benefit from guidance on when to use premium models for complex tasks.

targets.expr: sum by (user_login) (count_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | ai_credits_used=="0" | prompt_count > 0 [28d]))
